writing.overall_comment: A well-structured and semantically accurate skill document that would benefit from a concrete example and coverage of edge cases to improve robustness.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name and description accurately reflect the skill's purpose of summarizing session context for handoff, including tasks, decisions, and next steps.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: It provides an output template but no concrete worked example and does not address failure paths such as empty sessions, missing context, or blocked-task handling beyond a status label.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: The responsibilities and structured handoff format are clear and executable, but steps remain somewhat generic, lacking guidance on where to source session data or tools to gather state.

suggestions: Add a concrete worked example to the handoff output template section that shows a fully populated handoff (inputs, session source, and final structured output) so users can copy the expected format.

Add explicit failure-path instructions in the process section for empty sessions, missing context, and blocked tasks, specifying what data to collect, what status to assign, and when to escalate or stop.
Add guidance in the responsibilities/steps section on where to source session data and which tools or commands to use to gather current state before producing the handoff.
